source.repository: Independent seeded synthetic grammar derived from H families; not third-party
source.test_design: K data and SQL created after the hierarchical suffix proof checker froze, before any K execution. Adds alternate COUNT argument, MIN, quadruple grouping, new NULL/duplicate rows.
source.limitations: Family-correlated targeted prospective check, not production representativeness.
